The table test

01

Set your phone down.

Screen facing up, with stable contact on the table. Keep this page visible.

  1. 00–05sHands off. Let it settle.
  2. 05–15sLeave the table completely still.
  3. 15–25sTap lightly, about 20 cm away. Space taps apart.
  4. 25–35sMake a few firmer taps at the same distance.
  5. 35–45sGently press the phone down, then release.

The first 5 seconds set the graph’s baseline. Every available reading is recorded, including settling. A slow, steady press may produce little movement.

Change uses each run’s strongest channel. Export all runs to compare the same axes. The most recent 8 speaker runs are kept in this browser when storage is available.

What is actually being measured? +

Safari supplies accelerometer and rotation readings. We save each delivered motion event with its time, acceleration, acceleration including gravity, rotation, and current test step. The graph shows acceleration relative to the starting baseline; tilting or picking up the phone also changes it.

* Peak excludes the first 5 seconds of a recording. The delivery rate is measured from incoming events, not a promised hardware rate. Tiny or very fast vibrations may be missed. A flat graph does not prove that the table did not vibrate.

Speaker tests play known tones or your local audio file after 10 seconds of quiet, followed by 10 more seconds of quiet. Bluetooth introduces output delay; timestamps describe scheduled browser playback, not measured arrival at the speaker. The analysis compares signed raw sensor channels with the reference sound’s amplitude envelope. It does not recover spoken words.

Recording runs while this page is visible. Switching apps or locking the screen stops the session and playback. A gap of more than 3 seconds without usable readings also stops it. Free recording is limited to 10 minutes.

No microphone, camera, or accessibility access. Audio files are processed locally; no audio or sensor data is uploaded automatically. Recordings stay in this browser until you explicitly share them. Export before clearing browser data.
